title: Fundamentals of Hybrid Electric Vehicles
description: Advances in hybrid electric propulsion technology; hybrid electric powertrain system and key components, engines, fuel cells, transmissions, energy storage systems; and electric drives; modeling and simulation of vehicle performance, energy efficiency and emissions using advanced modeling tools; design and control optimization of hybrid electric propulsion systems for vehicles and marine vessels; and research on optimal design and control of hybrid electric propulsion system.
notes: Credit will be granted for one of MECH 558, MECH 459, MECH 580 (if taken in the same topic).
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
